text: Alfa-Bank's largest shareholder is Andrey Kosogov: he has held a 41% stake since 2022, and co-founders Mikhail Fridman and Petr Aven sold their shares to him in a sale closed in 2024.
short: Alfa-Bank's largest shareholder is Andrey Kosogov.

source.name: Kommersant: Чем известен акционер Альфа-банка Андрей Косогов
source.quote: В марте того же года господин Косогов стал крупнейшим бенефициаром Альфа-банка с долей 41%.
source.note: Russian original; English: 'In March of that year [2022] Mr Kosogov became Alfa-Bank's largest beneficiary with a 41% stake.'

additionalSources.name: Deutsche Welle (Russian service): Фридман и Авен из-за санкций продали доли в "Альфа-Банке"
additionalSources.quote: Тем самым Косогов, не находящийся под санкциями, стал крупнейшим акционером "Альфа-Банка"
additionalSources.note: English: 'Kosogov, who is not under sanctions, thereby became the largest shareholder of Alfa-Bank.' Citing the Financial Times, the article reports the sale of Fridman's and Aven's stakes was closed in 2024.
